title: QuietModeState
description: Whether F.R.I.D.A.Y. currently holds back spoken announcements. temporary: set for a limited time by voice or dashboard; schedule: the nightly quiet hours of the notification settings. Held announcements are summarized afterwards.

until.description: End of the current quiet period; null when not active.

temporaryUntil.description: End of a temporary quiet mode, also when the schedule currently applies.
